strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a primitive full-support density condition to the class and either require f_P=2^{-d} explicitly for the transverse benchmark or replace F_0 with an estimated density and prove the required ratio control.

State Bonvini--Kennedy--Keele Lemma 3 conditions 1--3 in the proposal and prove each from the proposed spline construction; do not describe the upper transfer as verified until the density-ratio condition is covered.

For a durable field contribution, prove the converse and achievability under the comparator's standard bounded-density/design conditions rather than relying on a known-uniform-density submodel, then retain the calibrated witness only as a nonemptiness corollary.
